closingKeywordReason: Slice: this PR ships proposal 1 (--strict-budget, on by default under CI). Proposal 2 (chunked push) stays open on the issue for manual reconciliation.
assumptions: Opt-out form is the paired boolean flag --no-strict-budget, matching the CLI's existing --no-collected; the last of --strict-budget / --no-strict-budget on the line wins.
'Under CI' means the CI env var is set to a non-empty value other than 'false' or '0' (case-insensitive).
A strict-budget refusal exits 1 (the command's existing 'nothing was ingested' code), not a new exit code.
Only the two lossy outcomes named in fork F3 are refused: a dropped catalog, or a body still over budget. Cutting error stacks to 1 KB alone is not refused.
--dry-run is unchanged: it prints the unfitted payload and is not budget-checked, since it sends nothing.
Scope is `canary testtracker push` only; the Playwright ingest reporter keeps its warn-and-push fit (fitPayload now reports catalogDropped/overBudget, so a follow-up could reuse it).
No env-var equivalent (e.g. CANARY_INGEST_STRICT_BUDGET) was added; the flag and the CI default cover the decided behaviour.

answeredForks.F3: a: --strict-budget, ON by default under CI; chunking stays open
